The '''Mark 4e/S heavy laser cannon''' was manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] It was developed to be used on the [[Imperial-class 1-H repulsortank/Legends|Imperial Repulsortank 1-H]], employed as the vehicle's main gun.
